hero_lead: Annual grants of $5,000–$50,000 flow to vetted grassroots partners delivering nutrition, education, and water & sanitation to vulnerable children.
fund_1_text: Daily staples (rice, lentils, cooking oil, eggs and milk) plus vitamins reach over 1,000 children every day through the grassroots partners we fund.
fund_2_text: From 2006–2016 we sponsored girls' education through elementary and high school at Loreto Sealdah School in Calcutta. Today we fund school supplies, textbooks, and ongoing education sponsorships.
fund_3_text: We've built schools, classrooms, toilets and wells across Calcutta, Hyderabad, Kaliayampoondi, Delhi and Pune (India); Karachi (Pakistan); Kathmandu and earthquake-affected villages (Nepal); Lumwana West (Zambia); Johannesburg (South Africa); and Croix de Bouquet (Haiti).
who_benefits_heading: Every program centers the most vulnerable children
field_heading: What your grant looks like on the ground
field_intro_1_text: Grants cover desks, textbooks, uniforms and tuition so a single unpaid fee doesn't end a child's schooling.
field_intro_2_text: Wells, latrines and handwashing stations cut down the disease and lost school-days that come with unsafe water.

partners_lede: We fund organizations already succeeding on the ground, helping them sustain and expand proven work.
